headline: Grizbo Build
title: Grizbo Build | Critical Hit and Rock Smash | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Grizbo is an Earth damage dealer that you get by evolving Cubbo at level forty seven after beating Alpha Grizbo. Guides run Critical Hit with a claw skill, Fanatic Clawing or Claw of Madness. Rock Smash is the big finisher, leaping high and slamming down on nearby enemies. Ferocious Fang is the held item most guides pick, and attack is the stat to stack. Do you run Grizbo? Comment below!
description: Grizbo build in Aniimo: Earth damage dealer, Critical Hit with Fanatic Clawing or Claw of Madness, Rock Smash finisher, Ferocious Fang held item. Evolve Cubbo at level 47 after beating Alpha Grizbo.
joke: Grizbo claws first and asks questions never.
